name: Gilshalan Windwalker
summary: At Aldrassil's roots in Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker studies the corruption spreading through Teldrassil. His work begins with the Webwood spiders and their growing aggression.

sections.title: A Scholar at the Roots
sections.body: Gilshalan Windwalker watches Shadowglen from the stone steps at Aldrassil's entrance. Teldrassil was planted to restore the night elves' lost sanctuary and their harmony with nature, yet signs of spiritual malaise appeared almost at once. Gilshalan studies how the corruption affects the local beasts, beginning with the venomous spiders weaving webs nearby.

sections.title: The Webwood Menace
sections.body: Gilshalan studies the Webwood spiders in Shadowthread Cave, north of Shadowglen. Once part of the forest's balance, the spiders have grown hostile and tainted. He sends young novices to gather venom sacs and intact eggs. By studying them, he hopes to learn how the venom has changed and whether the corruption passes through generations or spreads from Teldrassil's soil.

sections.title: Word to the Archdruid
sections.body: Gilshalan believes the spiders' venom may bear signs of the new World Tree's recent growth. He arranges to send the venom and an egg to Darnassus, where he will continue his studies. He also tells promising protectors that Tenaron Stormgrip seeks them in Aldrassil's highest room, where the druidic leadership watches over the young World Tree.

faq.answer: Gilshalan Windwalker studies the wildlife at Aldrassil in Shadowglen. The night elf scholar investigates the corruption affecting Teldrassil's creatures.

faq.q: Why does Gilshalan want Webwood venom?
faq.answer: Gilshalan wants Webwood venom to study how it has changed and why the spiders have grown so aggressive and tainted.

faq.q: What does he do with the Webwood egg?
faq.answer: Gilshalan sends the Webwood egg to Darnassus with the venom so he can study the specimens there. An unhatched egg is easier to transport than a grown giant spider, which is too dangerous to capture.

faq.q: Where does Gilshalan send adventurers next?
aliases: who do i see after gilshalan
faq.answer: Gilshalan tells adventurers that Tenaron Stormgrip seeks them in Aldrassil's highest room, and sends them there.
Gilshalan sits on the stone pathway at Aldrassil's northern base, outside the hollow entrance to the central tree in Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why is the wildlife in Teldrassil aggressive?
faq.answer: The cause of Teldrassil's aggressive wildlife is unknown. A blight seeping through the tree's roots and soil corrupts the creatures' minds and nature, drawing concern from residents like Gilshalan.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Gilshalan's early effort to understand why the young World Tree already bears violent, afflicted wildlife.
As a druid, you see how Gilshalan's research aids the Cenarion Circle's effort to diagnose the ecological imbalance in Shadowglen's boughs.
